title: ManualCandidatesSpec
description: USER-OVERRIDE candidate set for the search controller. Bypasses the automated Model-Scout / catalog candidate proposal: the user names the exact model families to fit, their per-candidate hyperparameters, and their per-candidate feature selection. Labels, KPI, targets and the walk-forward/eval contract still come from the referenced Trade Objective — this spec only replaces the WHICH-model(s) decision, never the WHAT-counts-as-success decision.

objective_id.description: Optional cross-check. If present it MUST equal the objective_id the search runs against, or the loader raises — guards against pairing a spec with the wrong objective.

ensembles.description: Whether to still run the Stage-2 ensemble layer over the manual candidates' cached OOF. Default false: manual mode fits exactly the models the user listed and nothing more. Overridden by the controller's own ensembles flag when explicitly set.

candidates.description: The exact models to build/fit/score. Order is preserved; each is evaluated independently on the objective's walk-forward folds.

id.description: Unique candidate id — used for leaderboard rows and OOF/diagnostics filenames. Defaults to `family`. MUST be unique across candidates; set it explicitly when several candidates share one family (e.g. two XGBoost configs).

family.description: Registered plugin/catalog family to build the model with, e.g. 'xgboost', 'lightgbm', 'attention_lstm'. Must exist in src/models/catalog.py.

params.description: Hyperparameter overrides merged over the family's catalog params_default. Keys are family-specific (see the family's plugin / catalog params_default).

max_rows.description: Training-fold row cap (reproducible subsample, seed 42). null / omitted = use ALL rows. Manual mode defaults to the full matrix (no search cap) since the user is deliberately fitting these models, not sweeping them.

search_space.description: Optional Optuna space for this candidate (ADR-040). Omitted / empty = no auto-tuning (ADR-019 default). Custom Test emits a subset of the family's catalog search_space when the slot enables HPO.

feature_selection.description: Explicit feature pick for this candidate. Exactly ONE of view / prefixes / columns. Omitted = the full feature matrix.

view.description: A named curated view from src/models/feature_views.py (e.g. 'regime_core', 'sequence_baseline', 'microstructure').

prefixes.description: Keep every feature column whose name starts with any of these prefixes, e.g. ['vw_', 'rv_', 'dc_'].

columns.description: Keep exactly these feature columns (exact-name match).
